monitor.summary: Recent updates deliver AI-powered query analysis to help diagnose performance issues across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MySQL, plus new cost visibility for cloud virtual machines and native ServiceNow and Microsoft Teams integrations for streamlined alert workflows. Enterprise customers gain expanded monitoring capabilities including permissions tracking for Azure Managed Instances and SQL Audit support.

highlights: Added cost breakdown visibility for AWS EC2 and Azure virtual machines so you can see exactly what's driving your cloud bills.
New alert type for server role membership changes alerts you immediately when user permissions are added or removed.
Query Executions tab now shows tempdb spill metrics to identify queries causing performance slowdowns through excessive disk usage.
View detailed cost breakdowns for AWS EC2 instances directly in Monitor with daily cost trends and comparison overlays.
Improved cloud credential testing provides clearer error messages to quickly resolve connection issues.
PostgreSQL Aurora read replicas are now automatically monitored alongside your cluster for complete visibility into read-heavy workloads.
AI analysis now available for Long-running query, Deadlock and Blocking process alerts to instantly understand root causes.
Exclude specific databases from alerts by name across multiple alert types for cleaner, more targeted notifications.
Azure virtual machine cost details now visible in Monitor for better cloud cost management.
Custom metrics now supported on Oracle instances for detailed monitoring of business-critical SQL.
Query compare functionality added for PostgreSQL Top queries to analyze performance differences.
New alert type for SQL Audit file rollovers detects when audit records may be lost due to rapid file rotation.
Disk read and write latency metrics now available for Amazon RDS hosts to diagnose storage performance issues.
SQL Audit events can now be filtered by custom date and time ranges for granular security investigations.
New Analysis graph experience is now default, offering faster performance and modern interface with option to revert to classic view.
SQL Server current activity tabs now show CPU and memory usage per session for instant performance context.
Index sampling now enabled by default for PostgreSQL to provide automatic index usage insights.
New CPU metric for Linux hosts excludes hypervisor steal time for more accurate performance reporting.
PostgreSQL top waits now visible on server and database overview pages to quickly identify performance bottlenecks.
Custom metric alerts can now include results from a secondary SQL query for richer context when troubleshooting.
PostgreSQL tracked queries now available from database overview page for easier query tracking.
SQL Server Availability Group page now displays backup priority for each replica to optimize your backup strategy.
Current activity pages with AI capability now available for Oracle and MySQL instances to diagnose query performance in real-time.
Virtual Machines page now displays Azure resource details including cost information for complete cloud visibility.
All notification types can be rate-limited to prevent alert fatigue from high-volume alert conditions.
SQL Audit tab now available in preview to track permission changes and audit events on SQL Server instances.
AI-powered query analysis on Current activity tabs helps diagnose why queries are slow and suggests improvements.
Virtual Machines comparison toggle allows year-over-year or period-over-period usage analysis.
AI-powered query analysis now supports Oracle and MySQL in addition to SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
Tags can now be applied to SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases for flexible alert suppression by database.
7-day history option added to Server overview History tab for extended trend analysis.
Certificate authentication for PostgreSQL on Linux servers now available (preview) for more secure connections.
Query tracking now available for PostgreSQL alongside SQL Server for consistent workload management.
MySQL instances on AWS Aurora now supported for unified monitoring of your Aurora databases.
Virtual Machines page can now compare usage across different time periods to identify trends.
AI-powered query analysis (preview) provides automated advice on query performance issues and improvement suggestions.
Custom metrics and alerts now available for PostgreSQL to monitor application-specific workloads.
Virtual machines page added to monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage across your infrastructure.
New SQL Server replication page tracks replication job activity in real-time for better visibility.
Native ServiceNow integration automatically creates incidents when alerts occur, eliminating manual ticket creation.
Native Microsoft Teams integration sends alert notifications directly to Teams channels for team visibility.
MySQL instances on Azure Flexible Server now supported for unified cloud database monitoring.
Oracle Data Guard monitoring now supported for disaster recovery visibility.
Query Executions page now shows Memory Grants to identify memory pressure and spill conditions.
